timeline.text:
I call on Marylanders in the Prince George’s County region and beyond to assist in the efforts to locate missing UMD student Dilan Shaan Ashar.

Please direct any information you may have with @UMPD at 301-405-3555 and continue to amplify this critical search with your neighbors and within your networks.

I join Dilan’s family and the entire UMD community in praying for his safety and that he is found quickly.
